newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends firm, Brent rides U.S. mogas rall.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends firm, Brent rides U.S. mogas rall.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures ended firm on Wednesday after a session dominated by a U.S.-led rally following the release of weekly inventory data showing big falls in crude and gasoline stocks.
Aug gas oil closed $3.25 firmer at $171 a tonne. Sept Brent, meanwhile, put on 24 cents to $18.83 a barrel by 1645 GMT, dragged higher by robust gains on U.S. markets.
"NYMEX gasoline led the way all afternoon," said a broker.
U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) data showing nationwide gasoline stocks fell 3.5 million barrels last week provided the new spur.

Concerns about possible supply disruption were also pushing NYMEX gasoline higher after a catalyst leak forced Tosco Corp to shut down a catalytic cracking unit at its 250,000 barrels per day (bpd) Bayway refinery on Wednesday.
"It's probably going to be down for two weeks; that's what the scenario looks like right now," said a source close to the refinery.
Exxon Corp said a 110,000 bpd fluid catalytic cracking unit in Texas downed by lightning Monday night remained out of service Wednesday morning.
DOE confirmation of the American Petroleum Institute (API)'s report of a big draw in crude stocks was adding to the momentum.
The API data, released late on Tuesday, showed U.S. crude stocks fell 9.7 million barrels last week, against expectations of a draw of about two million barrels.
Wednesday's DOE figures put the crude draw at an even heftier 9.9 million barrels.
But some brokers cast doubt on the reliability of the crude figures, given a repeat of the previous week's robust level of imports and a fall in average refinery operating rates.
